title: Multi-Partner Project: Key Enabling Technologies for Cognitive Computing Continuum - MYRTUS Project Perspective
problem: Building distributed, heterogeneous computing systems across edge-fog-cloud continuum requires abstractions, orchestration mechanisms, and design environments that are currently lacking.
motivation: EU CloudEdgeIoT Initiative mandates integration of edge, fog, and cloud resources; collaborative distributed systems require cognitive orchestration for high performance and energy efficiency.
method: The project creates tools to manage computing resources spread across edge devices (at network boundaries), fog nodes (in between), and cloud servers (centralized). It uses cognitive orchestration—intelligent algorithms that automatically place tasks where they'll run most efficiently based on current conditions. It provides one unified environment where developers design and manage these distributed systems without separately handling each layer's unique technical requirements.
key_novelty: Unified design and intelligent orchestration across the entire edge-fog-cloud computing continuum.
contributions: Abstractions for heterogeneous computing resources across continuum
Cognitive orchestration mechanisms for automated resource management
Unified design environment for continuum applications
limitations: Not discussed; project overview lacks specific performance results.
